description: This file contains the main activity class for an Android application that manages permission requests and logging. It extends a base activity, sets up the UI including fragments and menu options, and initializes logging infrastructure.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: Main launcher activity that manages UI components and logging for the permission request sample app.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the layout, and adds the PermissionRequestFragment if no saved state exists.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Inflates the options menu from XML.

methods.name: onPrepareOptionsMenu
methods.description: Adjusts menu item visibility and title based on current state.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles menu item selections, toggling log visibility.

methods.name: initializeLogging
methods.description: Sets up logging chain with custom log nodes and filters.
